description: This file contains the implementation of a custom soft keyboard input method for Android, including UI initialization, key handling, input processing, candidate management, and support for various keyboard modes and states.

classes.name: SoftKeyboard
classes.description: Main class implementing the soft keyboard input method, handling initialization, input processing, key events, candidate suggestions, and UI management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the input method service, obtaining necessary system services and resource strings.

methods.name: onInitializeInterface
methods.description: Sets up keyboard layouts, recreating keyboard objects if display size has changed.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Inflates the input view layout and sets the default keyboard.

methods.name: onCreateCandidatesView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the candidate view for suggested words.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Prepares the keyboard and prediction settings based on the type of input being edited.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets composing text and candidate suggestions when input finishes.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Applies the current keyboard layout when the input view starts.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Clears candidate suggestions if the cursor position changes significantly.

methods.name: onDisplayCompletions
methods.description: Updates candidate suggestions based on editor-provided completions.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key presses, including character input, delete, shift, mode changes, and language switch.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Handles insertion of a complete text sequence into the input.

methods.name: commitTyped
methods.description: Commits the current composing text to the input connection.

methods.name: updateShiftKeyState
methods.description: Updates the shift state of the keyboard based on cursor position and input type.

methods.name: handleBackspace
methods.description: Deletes the last character or commits empty text as appropriate.

methods.name: handleShift
methods.description: Toggles shift state or switches to shifted/non-shifted keyboard layouts.

methods.name: handleCharacter
methods.description: Processes character input, handling capitalization if shift is active.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Commits current text and requests the input method to hide.

methods.name: handleLanguageSwitch
methods.description: Switches to the next input method.

methods.name: checkToggleCapsLock
methods.description: Detects double-tap shift for caps lock toggle.

methods.name: isWordSeparator
methods.description: Determines if a character is a word separator.

methods.name: pickDefaultCandidate
methods.description: Selects the first candidate suggestion.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Manually selects a candidate suggestion based on index.
